Everything Icarus draws can now be hidden from recorders and screen sharing.

## New

- **Hide from recorders.** A "Hide from recorders" checkbox sits next to the theme selector, on the config page or in the pinned config group.
  - While it's on, the menu, the toasts and the HUD (the watermark and every other HUD element) are drawn in separate windows laid over the game. OBS, Discord, Snipping Tool and other capture can't see those windows. To the player it looks exactly the same.
  - Display capture leaves them out. Window capture and OBS Game Capture only see the game's own window, which no longer has them in it.
  - Mouse and keyboard input work as before.
  - The choice is saved in `icarus.json`.
  - In code: `mod.setHiddenFromRecorders(true)`, `mod.isHiddenFromRecorders()` and `Icarus.canHideFromRecorders()`. `IcarusOptions.recorderToggle(false)` removes the checkbox.
- **Your own overlays can be hidden too.** Anything your mod draws as a HUD element (`mod.addHud(...)`) follows the setting, so ESP boxes, indicators and the like can be kept off recordings:
  ```java
  mod.addHud((canvas, hud) -> canvas.rect(x, y, w, h, 0x80FF0000));
  ```

## Limits

- **Windows 10 2004 or later only.** Elsewhere the checkbox isn't shown and everything is drawn in game as before.
- **Not on 1.7.10.** Minecraft 1.7.10 doesn't ship JNA, which this needs; the checkbox isn't shown there.
- **Hidden things are drawn above Minecraft's own screens.** In game the HUD is drawn under the chat, the inventory and Minecraft's toasts; while hidden, the watermark and your HUD elements are on top of them.
- **Minecraft's own screen background is still recorded.** The dimming, and the blur on 1.21+, show that a screen is open.
- **It costs CPU while something changes.** Hidden layers are drawn on the CPU, typically a few milliseconds per frame while the menu animates. Nothing is redrawn while it's still, and dragging the menu only moves its window.

## Also

- The skeet background draws about 80,000 fewer quads per frame. The pixels are the same.
- Headless snapshots no longer drop or double-draw pixels on quad diagonals.

```groovy
repositories { maven { url "https://repo.dreamys.studio/" } }
dependencies { implementation "studio.dreamys:icarus-<loader>-<minecraft version>:3.1.1" }
```
